subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Fit as a fiddle

options.text: To be extremely excited and energetic

solution:
The correct answer is '**To be in good health.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'Fit as a fiddle'**- is an idiom means to be in very good health(अच्छा स्वास्थ्य)

 
 
• **Example** - I feel fit as a fiddle this morning.<
